title: Run Dashboard launch tests on an installed project

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The shared-machine Dashboard backend test caught a fixture-created catalog checkout that was missing its Codex execution-start script.

The promise for `SEED-433#run-dashboard-launch-tests-on-an-installed-project` is that both native layouts are installed in the catalog checkout and concurrent starts reuse that checkout and its matching bare origin. The probe covered the `doughnut` catalog project on one fixture machine at published revision `0a16b5242d6e246034d172a0eae8cbe5c9923966`. [Story scope](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/0a16b5242d6e246034d172a0eae8cbe5c9923966/.planning/seeds/SEED-433-run-dashboard-launch-tests-on-an-installed-project.md#L48) · [Slice 10](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/0a16b5242d6e246034d172a0eae8cbe5c9923966/.planning/slice-plans/816-run-dashboard-launch-tests-on-an-installed-project/PLAN.md#L390)

In a clean detached scratch worktree, the strict, one-worker Dashboard backend command selected the same single maintained test for every run. The baseline passed. I removed `.agents/skills/dough-execute-plan/scripts/execution-start.mjs` after the staged install check and just before the checkout moved to its final path. An independent filesystem observer saw the Codex script missing in the published scratch checkout, with the Claude script and origin still present. Both servers started, and the test's shared-checkout comparison passed before the native-layout existence assertion failed with “expected true, received false.” I restored the file, verified the exact clean status and revision, and reran the same case successfully. The observer found both scripts in the restored run. I removed the owned scratch checkout and runtime directory. [Fault location](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/0a16b5242d6e246034d172a0eae8cbe5c9923966/dashboard/test-support/support/catalogProjectOrigin.ts#L89) · [Maintained assertion](https://github.com/terryyin/open-dough/blob/0a16b5242d6e246034d172a0eae8cbe5c9923966/dashboard/backend-tests/launches/agent-launch-records-shared-machine.spec.ts#L98) · [Strict proof and witness logs](/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.git/open-dough/evidence/SEED-433-intent-coverage)

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing assertion for this path. The probe supports no additional test repair.

- **Test runtime.** 28.810 seconds measured in the runner's proof records. The baseline took 6.383 seconds, the faulted run 5.419 seconds, and the restored run 5.501 seconds. An initial passing baseline took 11.506 seconds and was repeated after the scratch wrapper failed to save its exit status.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. There was no separate measurement of human time.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. No independent active-agent time counter was available.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 642545 ms (measured), from 1795591639595 to 1795592282140 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Checked `0a16b5242d6e246034d172a0eae8cbe5c9923966`. Caught. Keep the maintained assertion. No follow-up.
